hypothesis: Hashed unordered BPE-count vectors erase relative action order and restrict learned KNN transfer; order-aware relation features may improve heldout predictions
scope: KnnLogicalUnit<string,string> only; NOT direct evidence RP01 DPO or end-user translation

rules.SAFE: BACKUP before DELETE for the same asset
rules.UNSAFE: DELETE before BACKUP for the same asset

fixed.baseInput: raw input; 64D production-equivalent vector plus 128 zero slots
fixed.enhancedInput: same 64D vector plus 128 generic (BPE token ID, 4 position-bin) features; no learned-label logic in encoder
fixed.tokenizerPolicy: one frozen BpeTokenizer trained only on raw TRAIN16; shared by A and B
fixed.primaryIndex: BruteForceIndex exact cosine, k=1, identical sorted TRAIN IDs
fixed.positiveOutcome: B>=12/16, improvement>=4/16 vs A; no added false SAFE, flipped training labels change outputs
fixed.warning: Real KnnLogicalUnit with HNSW is a separate A-only shadow check; don't use differently retrained BPE in primary A/B
